description: This file defines the CliLoggerFormatter class which implements the FormatterInterface from Monolog. It provides custom formatting for log messages in CLI, including color coding based on log levels, message padding, and batch formatting.

classes.name: CliLoggerFormatter
classes.description: A formatter class for CLI logging that applies color coding and message formatting based on log levels.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes color codes and sets up the log message format and padding.

methods.name: formatBatch
methods.description: Formats a batch of log records into a single output (note: implementation appears to overwrite the $formatted array in each iteration).

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a single log record, applying color coding based on level, adding padding, and including timestamps.

methods.name: getColors
methods.description: Returns an array of ANSI color codes used for formatting.

methods.name: code
methods.description: Utility method to generate ANSI escape sequences based on a color code.

methods.name: getColourAndCode
methods.description: Determines appropriate color and symbol based on log level.
